name: peach-anime-film
label: quiet theatrical anime
hard_rules: No mobile-game illustration look: no glossy gradients, no rim light on every edge, no sparkles
Characters have individual faces, never the same face

likes.trait: fine lines with slight weight variation, thinner on distant objects
restrained two-tone cel shading on characters
muted, slightly desaturated palette with one warm accent
hand-painted backgrounds with haze and depth
subject small and off-centre in a wide frame

dislikes.trait: huge glossy eyes with multiple sparkles
neon purple-cyan glow without a light source

gemini: Say 'a theatrical anime film look rather than a game illustration' explicitly
Use a style reference image when available

evidence.summary: Preferred image A (painted background, matte shading) over B (glossy, neon, centred)
